Hi Elena —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the procurement onboarding. Attached is a short checklist to speed the portal provisioning (procurement-kickoff-checklist.pdf). To avoid delays, can you please confirm the following by EOD tomorrow: 

- Legal entity name exactly as registered
- VAT / Tax ID and country of registration
- Registered address and DUNS number (if available)
- Bank wiring details for PO payments (IBAN/SWIFT) — we can mask in transit
- Primary technical contact for SSO/SAML metadata (name + email)

We primarily provision suppliers through Ariba for our EU flows; if you already have an active Ariba account please reply with the Ariba org ID and any screenshots of errors you saw when claiming the organization. If Ariba is blocked we can provision a Coupa fallback but that takes an extra 24–48 hours.

Next steps from our side: Laura will validate the identity docs for procurement, Ben will confirm whether we need manual provisioning, and I will coordinate the PO workflow and initial payment terms.

Would you have 20 minutes tomorrow at 09:30 CET for a quick screenshare to look at the portal error you mentioned? If that slot doesn't work suggest two others.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the docs and context. I reviewed the incorporation file and the Ariba note. We can proceed two ways:

1) Manual provisioning (fast): If you complete the attached CSV (manual-provisioning-form.csv) and return it, I can create a temporary Redwood vendor account so POs can be issued within 24 hours. Payments will route to the provided bank details.

2) Ariba transfer (preferred for long-term): We can open the Ariba support ticket from our partner portal and attach the transfer packet. That process typically takes 3–7 business days depending on Ariba review and exec sign-off at your old admin email. We recommend running manual provisioning in parallel to avoid business disruption.

Action items: 
- Elena: please fill manual-provisioning-form.csv and send back. If you want, give me the exec contact for the old-accts@acmetech.com admin and I will include them on the Ariba ticket.
- Laura: once we have the filled CSV I will request the temporary vendor ID and post the onboarding notes to the shared drive.

Elena — once manual provisioning is live I will send a sample PO and the PO-to-invoice routing instructions (email and portal where invoices should be uploaded).

Regards,
